baseline_models.focus_anchor: The two ح س ب occurrences in لَا يَحْتَسِبُ and فَهُوَ حَسْبُهُ are separated by حَيْثُ and the act of tawakkul.
baseline_models.mechanism: Human reckoning cannot locate the incoming share, then entrusting the affair turns the same root field from conjectural calculation into sufficient cover. The verse stages a controlled reversal: failed anticipation is not answered by better prediction but by adequacy supplied through a transferred reliance relation.

activation_trace.role: The allotted-gift image makes provision a share that arrives, supplying the object whose route the recipient cannot calculate.
The indeterminate-place image withholds the channel of arrival and creates the spatial gap in human forecasting.
The conjecture image supplies the uncertain expectation denied in يَحْتَسِبُ and marks the failed human side of the reversal.
The sufficiency-and-enrichment image supplies the answering sense in حَسْبُهُ and closes the deficit opened by failed expectation.
Handing an affair to another supplies the relational hinge by which prediction gives way to dependable sufficiency.

changed_reading.before: Provision is a generic reward promised after an act of piety.
changed_reading.after: The sentence deliberately breaks the recipient's forecast, transfers the affair, and answers the resulting epistemic deficit with sufficient cover rather than with disclosed advance knowledge.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ بَٰلِغُ أَمْرِهِ and قَدْ جَعَلَ ٱللَّهُ لِكُلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدْرًا follow the unknown source and sufficiency clauses.
baseline_models.mechanism: The latter half supplies an execution system for the first: an affair reaches its endpoint because every knowable thing has been assigned an extent. The route is opaque to the beneficiary, but it is neither unbounded nor improvised within the verse's own architecture.

activation_trace.role: Reaching a destination or terminal point supplies the execution endpoint for the divine affair.
The affair-or-state image supplies what is carried through to completion without forcing the noun into only a verbal command.
Causing a thing to be in a state supplies the assigning operation that places each thing under a measure.
The totalizing enclosure image expands the measure from this one crisis to every constituent thing.
The knowable-and-reportable thing image makes the scope distributive rather than an undifferentiated mass.
The quantity, boundary, and term image gives each thing a calibrated extent through which the affair can arrive at its end.

changed_reading.before: The unknown source suggests an unstructured miracle interrupting ordinary causality.
changed_reading.after: The surprise is local to the recipient's knowledge; within the verse it is an unseen route inside a measured system whose affair reliably reaches its endpoint.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: يَتَوَكَّلْ is immediately answered by حَسْبُهُ and then by بَٰلِغُ أَمْرِهِ.
baseline_models.mechanism: Tawakkul is read as delegation to an executor rather than inert withdrawal. The inventory preserves a nearby failure mode in which reciprocal offloading loses the affair; the verse blocks that failure by naming one sufficient party whose affair reaches completion.

activation_trace.role: Entrusting an affair to another supplies the operative agency relation rather than a merely inward mood.
Mutual reliance that lets an affair be lost supplies the contrastive failure mode that this one-directional entrustment avoids.
The sufficiency image identifies the entrusted party as adequate to carry what has been handed over.
Arrival at the endpoint supplies evidence of execution and prevents delegation from collapsing into neglect.

changed_reading.before: Tawakkul means becoming passive because the outcome belongs to God.
changed_reading.after: Tawakkul is an asymmetrical entrustment to a sufficient, endpoint-reaching executor; the verse contrasts it with the kind of offloading by which an affair would be lost.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context first forbids forcing women out and marks divine limits, then allows God to bring about a new affair and make an exit. This turns the focus's unknown route into a lawful reconfiguration that can emerge without manufacturing relief by violating another person's protected place.

activation_trace.role: The barrier-and-distinguishing-limit image supplies the protected perimeter within which any genuine relief must arise.
Passage to the outside supplies the concrete motion prohibited when humans would produce an exit by expulsion.
Coming to be after nonexistence supplies the possibility of a genuinely new arrangement after the boundary is observed.
The outward-passage image now becomes a divinely made outlet, reversing the prohibited human expulsion without erasing spatial movement.
The indeterminate location keeps the lawful outlet's route undisclosed at the point of trust.
Causing something to take a state links the made outlet to the later assignment of measure.

structural_cues: The prohibition on expulsion precedes both the possibility of a new affair and the promise of a made exit.
The focus follows immediately after مَخْرَجًا, so its مِنْ حَيْثُ can continue the spatial problem without repeating the noun.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies protected limits, forbidden expulsion, a newly arising affair, and a made outlet; I supply the arrow that limit-observance leaves room for a noncoercive route of provision. A live alternative is that the outlet and provision are parallel assurances rather than one mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Unexpected provision is a private windfall detached from the surrounding divorce procedure.
changed_reading.after: Unexpected provision can be the lawful outlet or new arrangement that appears while protected housing and limits remain intact, not an escape produced through wrongful displacement.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus's denial of human reckoning sits inside a procedure saturated with counted periods, exhaustive enumeration, fixed terms, witnesses, and justice. The activated distinction is between an uncomputable future source and duties that remain precisely countable and publicly accountable.

activation_trace.role: The counted waiting-period image supplies a legally bounded duration that must not dissolve into vague trust.
Exhaustive numerical enumeration supplies the demanded human act of exact counting.
The fixed endpoint of a term supplies the temporal boundary at which action changes.
Presence with witnessing supplies public observability for decisions made at the counted endpoint.
Justice in judgment supplies the norm governing that observable procedure.
Conjectural reckoning supplies the specifically unreliable calculation, contrasting with the context's mandated counts.

structural_cues: Imperatives to count, witness, and uphold justice frame the promise before the same root later returns as severe accounting.
لَا negates يَحْتَسِبُ, not the surrounding acts of enumeration or testimony.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies exact procedural counting beside an expressly unanticipated source; I infer a division between calculable obligation and incalculable outcome. A live alternative is that يَحْتَسِبُ simply means 'expect' with no deliberate contrast to legal enumeration.

changed_reading.before: Trust and unexpected provision authorize an anti-calculative posture in general.
changed_reading.after: The future channel cannot be privately forecast, yet periods, rights, evidence, and just action remain rigorously counted; uncertainty is no license for procedural vagueness.

context_deltas.mechanism: Reaching a term is embodied by the hidden load of pregnancy arriving at its appointed endpoint and then being laid down, after which ease is made. This activates بَٰلِغُ أَمْرِهِ and قَدْرًا as a maturation-and-release process, not only as sovereign declaration.

activation_trace.role: Arrival at a temporal endpoint supplies the first concrete instance of something reaching its assigned limit.
The inwardly carried load and fruit image supplies a hidden process developing before it becomes externally visible.
The appointed duration supplies the threshold governing when the hidden load completes.
Laying down a pregnancy by birth supplies the release event after the load reaches its term.
Opening into ease after difficulty supplies the post-release state made from the completed process.
The focus's endpoint-reaching image receives the gestational sequence as a concrete temporal model.
A thing's quantity, boundary, and term supplies the calibration by which maturation becomes release rather than indefinite suspension.

structural_cues: بَلَغْنَ, أَجَل, حمل, and يَضَعْنَ form a repeated endpoint sequence across 65:2 and 65:4.
The focus stands between the general reaching claim and the embodied pregnancy rule that follows it.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies endpoint vocabulary, a hidden load, its term, its release, and ensuing ease; I infer that this material sequence models how an unseen divine affair ripens into an event. A live alternative is that these are only adjacent legal timings with no metaphorical feedback into 65:3.

changed_reading.before: God's affair reaches its goal as an instantaneous override.
changed_reading.after: The affair may reach its goal like a hidden load maturing to a measured threshold and then being released; surprise at arrival can coexist with a timed process.

context_deltas.mechanism: Housing, spending, and burden are scaled to available means and capacity while deliberate constriction is prohibited. The explicit case of provision being narrowed activates qadr as calibration across both resource and obligation: sufficiency is fit, not necessarily abundance.

activation_trace.role: Dwelling in a residence supplies the concrete housing obligation to which provision and capacity must be fitted.
The means, plenty, and wealth image supplies the actual resource base from which accommodation is scaled.
Narrowing what is spacious supplies the prohibited manipulation that would turn measured means into imposed pressure.
Capacity and ability supply the upper dimension by which expenditure is proportioned.
The constriction-to-a-small-measure image makes scarcity an explicit case inside the same root field as the focus's measure.
Bearing a hardship or imposed claim supplies the obligation side that is capped by what has been given.
Sufficiency supplies adequacy, now sharpened as a relation between resources and demands rather than sheer quantity.
The bounded amount image supplies the common scale on which available provision and required performance can be matched.

structural_cues: 65:6 repeats مِنْ حَيْثُ in the housing instruction, relocating the focus's spatial phrase into domestic means.
65:7 places expansive capacity and constricted provision in parallel spending clauses, then caps burden by what was given.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies housing according to means, a ban on constriction, capacity-scaled spending, narrowed provision, and capped burden; I infer one proportional allocation mechanism governed by qadr. A live alternative is that these are separate ethical rules and qadr in 65:3 remains purely cosmic.

changed_reading.before: Divine sufficiency means that reliance should result in plentiful resources.
changed_reading.after: Sufficiency can consist in measured fit: real scarcity is acknowledged, duties contract to what was given, and human actors may not weaponize narrowness against dependents.

context_deltas.mechanism: When direct cooperation around nursing becomes difficult, the packet names wages, recognized dealing, and another nursing woman. This gives the focus's unknown source a social mechanism: provision can arrive through a replacement caregiver and a compensated care relation rather than through an ownerless windfall.

activation_trace.role: Taking milk from breast or udder supplies the concrete nourishment whose delivery channel can change.
Compensation for work supplies the economic link that sustains care without disguising it as costless charity.
Conduct recognized as good by reason and norm supplies the rule for negotiating the care arrangement.
Mutual opposition and complication supply the blockage that forces the route of care to branch.
Another after the first supplies the substitute human channel through which nursing continues.
The allotted-benefit image lets compensated nourishment count as a concrete form of provision.
The indeterminate-place image becomes an indeterminate social source: the needed care need not come through the initially expected person.

structural_cues: The substitute caregiver appears only after commands concerning housing, spending, nursing wages, and mutual consultation.
The care recipient remains the same while the provider and payment relation change.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a blocked primary arrangement, paid nourishment, and an explicit substitute; I identify that contingency as one concrete instantiation of provision from an unanticipated route. A live alternative is that the substitution rule is only procedural and does not interpret the promise in 65:3.

changed_reading.before: Provision from an unexpected source is imagined as money or food arriving without a visible human chain.
changed_reading.after: The unexpected source can be an alternate caregiver and a fair contract that preserves nourishment when the anticipated care relationship fails.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same ح س ب field that denies private expectation and promises sufficiency later becomes severe accounting for a community that defies its Lord's command. Its affair then acquires an aftermath of loss. Tawakkul therefore operates inside accountable obedience, not as immunity from the ledger.

activation_trace.role: Rebellion against obedience supplies the conduct that converts an affair from entrusted execution into exposure to judgment.
The binding-command image supplies the norm resisted by the community and sharpens one live sense of the focus's أَمْر.
Counting and accounting supply the severe audit pole of the root that supplied sufficiency in the focus.
The last part and outcome of a thing supplies the delayed result of how the affair was handled.
Commercial loss supplies a ledger-like rendering of the failed outcome produced by defiance.
Entrusting the affair supplies the relation now tested against the later case of resisting the entrusted party's command.
Sufficiency supplies one pole of a root whose other contextual pole is exacting account.

structural_cues: ح س ب appears twice in the focus and twice again in 65:8, but the grammatical agents and outcomes reverse.
65:8-9 moves from resisting أَمْر to accounting, experienced consequence, aftermath, and loss.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a repeated root, defied command, severe account, aftermath, and loss; I infer that the later audit constrains how tawakkul and sufficiency may be read earlier. A live alternative is that the punishment scene addresses a different audience and should coexist without qualifying the promise.

changed_reading.before: Reliance makes the believer exempt from managing accountable obligations because God is sufficient.
changed_reading.after: God's sufficiency coexists with exact account: entrustment is compatible with obedience and due performance, while defiant handling of the affair matures into measurable loss.

context_deltas.mechanism: A reminder is sent down, a messenger recites visible signs, and people are brought from concealment-darkness into light before the sequence closes by naming good provision. This activates an epistemic form of rizq: orientation itself can arrive through an unanticipated communicative channel.

activation_trace.role: Sending something down and delivering it supplies the directional arrival of the reminder.
A reminder that causes recollection supplies the content delivered rather than a material ration.
Following in sequence supplies recitation as a continuing relay from message to hearer.
The manifest-sign image supplies orienting marks by which the recipient can move despite prior nonknowledge.
Bringing something out of concealment supplies the transformation effected by the communicated signs.
Illumination supplies the newly visible field into which the hearer is brought.
The closing allotted-benefit image names the sequence's outcome as good provision and feeds that range back into 65:3.
The unknown-place image becomes an unknown channel of orientation, not only an unknown location of money or food.

structural_cues: 65:10-11 forms a delivery chain: sent reminder, messenger, recited signs, extraction from darkness, light, then good provision.
The terminal رِزْقًا can look backward over the communicative transformation as well as forward to the gardens.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the delivery chain and closes it with good provision; I infer that revelatory orientation participates in the provision rather than serving only as its precondition. A live alternative is that رِزْقًا refers narrowly to the garden reward just mentioned.

changed_reading.before: The provision in 65:3 is material maintenance whose source is hidden.
changed_reading.after: Provision can also be a sent reminder and recited signs that disclose a path out of darkness; what arrives unexpectedly may be usable orientation.

context_deltas.mechanism: Creation itself activates a measuring image, the affair descends among layered domains, capability covers every thing, and knowledge encloses every thing. The focus's qadr becomes a per-thing specification inside an administered cosmos; بَٰلِغُ describes execution through that system rather than a bare assertion of force.

activation_trace.role: Measuring and proportioning a thing supplies a design operation inside the act of creation itself.
Descent and arrival supply movement of the affair through the created vertical order.
A connection standing between endpoints supplies relational space through which the descending affair operates.
Disclosure of a thing to the knower supplies the epistemic scope that contains what remains unknown to the beneficiary.
Effective capability and mastery supply the power side of the same root field whose focus occurrence supplies each thing's measure.
Complete enclosure in knowledge and retention supplies the system boundary around every measured thing and route.
Totality and enclosure supply the repeated universal scope of capability and knowledge.
Each knowable, reportable thing supplies the individually addressable unit within that universal scope.
Endpoint arrival supplies the execution claim now embedded in a descending and encompassing cosmic mechanism.
Measured planning, preparation, and adjustment supply specification rather than only a fixed quantity.

structural_cues: 65:12 repeats كُلِّ شَىْءٍ twice and places قَدِير between the two universal clauses, echoing قَدْرًا in the focus.
The surah closes with the affair descending between created layers and knowledge enclosing the same total scope.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies measuring creation, descending command, universal capability, and encompassing knowledge; I infer a specification-and-execution architecture linking them back to qadr and بلوغ. A live alternative is that 65:12 is a concluding proof of power with no intended systems relation to the focus's measure.

changed_reading.before: قَدْرًا is a static decree assigning a fate to each object.
changed_reading.after: قَدْرًا can be a per-thing specification within a created, traversable, knowledge-enclosed order; divine capability executes measures along routes that remain locally unseen.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The cushion image is surprising because حَسْبُهُ is idiomatically sufficiency, not furniture. It remains anchored in the exact ح س ب inventory and gains material pressure from the housing context, but downstream prose should render it only as a support analogy: sufficiency acts as something placed beneath a destabilized person, not as a lexical translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: فَهُوَ حَسْبُهُ after the transfer expressed by يَتَوَكَّلْ.

activation_trace.role: The small cushion or seat image materializes adequacy as support placed under the one who has entrusted the affair.
Reliance supplies the body's figurative transfer of weight onto that support.
A place of settlement supplies the contextual need for stable support amid household displacement.

changed_reading.before: Sufficiency is an abstract balance-sheet condition.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, sufficiency is felt as load-bearing support beneath someone whose domestic footing and expected channels have become unstable.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This reading is cross-domain because it activates rain, heavy downpour, river flow, and sky branches around an ayah not explicitly describing weather. It remains anchored in the focus's own rain-as-rizq and measured-extent branches and in later water imagery; downstream prose should present it as an ecological analogy, not claim that 65:3 denotes meteorology.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: يَرْزُقْهُ and لِكُلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدْرًا hold a descending-provision branch beside a calibration branch.

activation_trace.role: Rain descending as provision supplies the life-giving inflow in the hydraulic analogy.
A bounded amount supplies the regulating measure that distinguishes sustaining flow from excess.
Heavy, violent rain supplies the harmful counterimage of descent whose weight exceeds easy assimilation.
The continuance of provision and giving supplies a sustained current rather than a one-time delivery.
A river cutting through land with running water supplies the channel that carries sustained provision.
The sky as what rises and overshadows supplies the upper reservoir of the analogy's vertical route.

changed_reading.before: Provision is a discrete item delivered to an individual, while measure is an unrelated decree.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, provision behaves like regulated water: unseen descent becomes sustaining flow when measured, while unassimilable heaviness becomes harmful consequence.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The relay is surprising because the agent-or-messenger branch of ج ر ي is distant from the manifest river verb in 65:11. It remains useful because the focus explicitly supplies entrustment and the context explicitly supplies a messenger and sequential recitation; downstream prose must call the ج ر ي contribution a branch echo, not parse تَجْرِى as 'acts as an agent.'
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: يَتَوَكَّلْ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ frames the focus as an entrusted relation whose outcome reaches the recipient.

activation_trace.role: Handing an affair to another supplies the initial delegation in the proposed relay.
The messenger-and-message image supplies an authorized intermediary rather than an ownerless transmission.
Following and succession supply the ordered relay by which signs reach their hearers.
The agent-or-messenger branch supplies a deliberately contained echo between delegated agency and the later running current.

changed_reading.before: Tawakkul is a private inward relation with no mediating structure.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, entrustment participates in a relay: affair, messenger, sequential signs, and flowing outcome form a chain of delegated transmission rather than a solitary state.

strongest_changes: The context separates mandatory counting of duties from the impossibility of forecasting the future source.
Unexpected provision becomes concrete as a lawful outlet, proportionate household maintenance, or substitute compensated care.
The repeated ح س ب field holds sufficiency and severe accountability together without collapsing either pole.
The sent reminder and recited signs keep an epistemic form of provision alive beside material and eschatological provision.
The closing creation scene revises qadr from a static fate into a per-thing specification inside descending execution and encompassing knowledge.
summary.what_was_special: The ayah's own double ح س ب and its endpoint-measure sequence became switching points for several coexisting mechanisms. Context did not merely add topics: it turned unknown provision into lawful spatial release, timed maturation, calibrated obligation, social substitution, accountable trust, communicative guidance, and cosmic execution, while the contained branch outliers preserved material-support, hydraulic, and relay analogies.
remaining_uncertainties: أَمْر can remain live as command, affair, and administered state; the context sharpens each without forcing a single scope everywhere.
The final رِزْقًا in 65:11 may name the garden reward narrowly or retrospectively include the revelatory transition that precedes it.
The cushion, hydraulic, and agent-relay images are branch activations rather than replacement glosses and require explicit qualification in downstream prose.
The gestational process may be an intended temporal model for بلوغ and qadr or only a neighboring legal embodiment of the same vocabulary.
